search_explanation: Read README, main.py, ingest.py, approvals.py, mcp_client.py, tools/slack.py, tools/documents.py and networkpolicy.yaml, and grepped the tree for webhook/callback/a2a/agent card/peer/response_url/reply_to. The only inbound routes are /runs (human OIDC JWT), /ingest/mail (mail gateway service, a non-agent HMAC-signed document feed), /slack/interactions (human approver button clicks) and /healthz. The ERP MCP server is a tool server the agent calls, and the LineItemExtractor sub-agent is an in-process call. There is no A2A server, no peer-agent endpoint, no agent card, and no peer-supplied callback or webhook URL.
note: No other agent sends messages to this agent: inbound traffic comes from humans (OIDC, Slack approvers) and a non-agent mail gateway, so E07 is not applicable. Residual caveat: the mail gateway HMAC is a single shared key with no per-sender mapping, and the ingest payload takes business_unit from the body, which would matter if the gateway were treated as a peer.
